name: Chris Padilla
summary: An American lightweight (18-7, age 31), 5-0-1 in his last six UFC fights. He drew with MarQuel Mederos in April and submitted Nasrat Haqparast with a second left in R3 in August.

how_they_fight.Striking: Long and powerful: nine knockouts (six in R1).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Six submissions, including a R3 finish of Haqparast.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped three times (one KO, two submissions) in his early career.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Finishes late as well as early.

keys_to_beat: Drag him into a grappling match
